newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Jan 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Jan 23.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Thursday:

* An aide to President Bill Clinton who is now an appointee at the Export-Import Bank tried to push through a multimillion dollar financing deal sought by a woman who is now being investigated for her large donations to the Democratic Party.
* Charles Feeney, the New Jersey businessman who made a fortune with duty-free shops, discloses that he secretly gave away $600 million in donations over the past 15 years.
* The Russian Parliament votes in favour of a nonbinding resolution to remove Yeltsin from office.
* Commerce Secretery nominee William Daley says he would seek to eliminate political agendas and 100 of 260 party-linked jobs in the department if he is confirmed.
* A Federal jury awarded Food Lion Inc $5.5 million in punitive damages from Walt Disney Co's ABC.
* Federal authorities charge officials of the former union that represented the city's transit police with racketeering and bribery.
